I refused entry without tenant consent or 24h notice, asked the contractor to confirm date and company, wrote to the tenants for access and number, and set a review for 16 Oct.

args.body: Hi Freya, thanks for letting us know. I'm sorry, but we can't let the contractor in with the office key without the tenants' agreement. Holding a key doesn't give us a right of entry, and entering without consent or proper notice isn't something we can do outside a genuine emergency (this is a routine job). Also, the contractor hasn't confirmed a visit for tomorrow; they've said Monday 20th PM, and I'm checking that date with them. What we can do: send the tenants written notice of the proposed visit at least 24 hours ahead, and keep trying to reach them by email and text. I'll update you once the contractor has confirmed the date. Next update from us by Wednesday 16 October.
